description: This source file defines the StructureBuilder class, a helper for adding structural elements to PDF documents according to PDF/UA standards. It manages a stack of structure items, creates structure elements, and links them with marked content and annotations, facilitating the construction of accessible PDF structures.

classes.name: StructureBuilder
classes.description: A helper class for adding structure to PDF documents, supporting various element types and managing the structure hierarchy, MCID assignments, and parent tree relationships.
